**docs: move #962 sixth-reader draft under #976, verify roster claims**

Copied openspec/changes/issue-962-release-gate-deny-reader/brain-drafts/deny-readers-roster-sixth.draft.md into a new change openspec/changes/issue-976-evidence-reader-roster/, retargeted its contract from issue:962 (closed) to issue:976 (open, approved), and rewrote the preamble so every sentence is true now: PR #969 fixed brain-audit.mjs's loadConfig and closed #962; issue #975 tracks a remaining, unfixed non-object-config-shape gap in loadBrainConfigOrThrow. Verified every reader the rewritten 'Applied at' paragraph names against source with file:line: six DENY readers propagate a config-read failure (approve/cli.mjs, vcs/actor-check.mjs, vcs/brain-writes-reviewed.mjs x2, brain-audit.mjs loadConfig), three ALLOW readers still degrade to empty, and governance/approved-label.mjs is reclassified out of the ALLOW list into the same ratified-fixed-fallback Exemption category as vcs/governance-tiers.mjs's resolveTier, since governance.approvedLabel is a single string degrading to DEFAULT_APPROVED_LABEL='status:approved', not a list. Also checked governance/lane-scrub.mjs, memory/backends/engram.mjs and memory/backends/plainfiles.mjs and confirmed they are a different reader category (secret-scrub config) and do not belong in the roster. Proved the draft promotable via a throwaway script against the real brain/scripts/lib/amendment-draft.mjs: parses ok, edit assesses pending with exactly one free anchor, applyEdits touches only the target paragraph (lines 90-103 of 104), and the result contains no leftover 'tracked in #962' text. brain:promote was never invoked -- the draft stays unapplied for the maintainer. Full suite: 5361 pass / 0 fail. brain:repo:check clean.
